Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Consultant : The consulting firm shall meet the following minimum experience criteria.
I. Background of the firm with a brochure.
ii. Minimum 05 years' experience of the firm for preparation of master plans, different surveys and assessments, preparation of
DPP, architectural & engineering design, drawings, estimation of civil works, preparation of IEE, EIA, EMP, SIA reports, and waste
management plans; and also have capability in economic and financial viability assessment and reporting on different fields of
science and technology sectors.
iii. Specific experience in preparing a feasibility study for a complete road network, DAP preparation, architectural & engineering
design, drawings, and estimation of civil works on a town road network under any institute/development authority/UDD of one
contract value of at least fifty (50.00) lakh taka.
iv. A summary of the professional qualifications and experience of technical staff with a valid mobile number.
v. Update trade licence, TIN certificate, VAT registration, and annual turnover of the last 3 (three) years of the firm.
vi. Minimum last 3 (three) years audit report of the firm.
vii. For engineering university or gov. institutions (BIM, IIFC, etc.), papers are not mandatory; those are quoted above.
Brief Description of assignment : Consultancy services for the preparation of a feasibility study report and draft development project proposal (DPP) and conceptual
design under the road construction survey project mentioned in the DAP in the area under the jurisdiction of the Gazipur
Development Authority.
